outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic and example micrograph illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b is a schematic and micrograph illustrating image spacing, not a plot.
Panel c is a schematic and micrograph illustrating insets/zoom, not a plot.
Panel d shows example micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment, not a plot.
Panel e shows schematic icons and micrographs illustrating channel annotation, not a plot.
Panel f shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating grayscale channel display, not a plot.
Panel g shows schematics and micrographs with calibration scales, not a plot of averaged data.
